newsitem.title: USA: NAL Financial named in shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: NAL Financial named in shareholder suit.

text.p: NAL Financial Inc was named in a shareholder lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida, a law firm said.

The lawsuit claims that NAL Financial misrepresented the adequacy of its underwriting guidelines and reserves for credit losses and that it overstated its earnings, the law firm of Lowey Dannenberg Bemporad & Selinger said.
The lawsuit was filed on behalf of purchasers of the common stock between April 2, 1996 and April 2, 1997, the law firm said.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
A NAL Financial spokeswoman said the company has not yet been served with the lawsuit and has no knowledge of this matter.
